# CC-17 — Conformance generator keeps the reason on a met grade

**Goal:** A `met` grade that has a `reason` keeps it in both generated files. Today the generator reads the reason only for a `not-met` or `n/a` criterion (`Unmet`), so the reason of a `met` grade reaches neither `docs/conformance.md` nor `docs/conformance.json` (CC-12 round 1 F2).
**Spec:** docs/specs/2026-11-25-client-model-design.md K§6.2.6 (the criteria list after the three outputs: a `met` line is the evidence, then `(reason: <reason>)` when the grade has a reason; the JSON cell key `met_reasons`, after `na`, only when such a criterion exists), K§6.2.5 (the generator, check item 10), K§6.2.3 (grade form), K§4 K-C7 (amended), K§11 item 24
**Files:** `crates/zygo-core/tests/conformance/render.rs`, `crates/zygo-core/tests/conformance/derive.rs`, `crates/zygo-core/tests/conformance.rs` (new test functions only), `docs/conformance.md`, `docs/conformance.json` (regenerated with `ZYGO_WRITE_CONFORMANCE=1`)
**Consumes:** `check-test-edits.sh` (CC-2)
**Produces:** the `met_reasons` cell key of `docs/conformance.json`; the `(reason: …)` suffix of a met line in `docs/conformance.md`
**Acceptance:** `test "$(cargo test -p zygo-core --test conformance --locked -- --list | grep -cxE 'render_(markdown|json)_met_reason_kept: test')" = 2 && cargo test -p zygo-core --test conformance --locked --no-fail-fast && grep -q '"met_reasons"' docs/conformance.json && grep -qE '^- A-[0-9.]+ met: .* \(reason: ' docs/conformance.md && cargo test --workspace --locked --no-fail-fast && S=$(git show "$(sed -n 's/^Parent: \([0-9a-f]\{40\}\)$/\1/p' docs/work/phase4/nodes/CC-17.md):scripts/check-test-edits.sh") && printf '%s\n' "$S" | sh -s -- "$(sed -n 's/^Parent: \([0-9a-f]\{40\}\)$/\1/p' docs/work/phase4/nodes/CC-17.md)" docs/work/phase4/nodes/CC-17.md` → every command exits 0: the two new tests are listed and pass. `render_markdown_met_reason_kept` gives a `met` grade of the render input a reason and asserts that its criteria line is `- <id> met: <evidence> (reason: <reason>)`, with the reason through `md_text`, and that a `met` grade with no reason keeps the line with no suffix. `render_json_met_reason_kept` asserts that the cell of that criterion has `met_reasons` `[{"criterion": <id>, "reason": <reason>}]` after `na`, and that a cell with no such criterion has no `met_reasons` key. The conformance test passes on the committed `docs/conformance.md` and `docs/conformance.json` (check item 10), and both hold a met reason; `cargo test --workspace --locked --no-fail-fast` is green on ubuntu, macOS and Windows CI

## Planning notes

- The drop is in the generator's derive and render steps, not in the parser: `model.rs:413-415` reads and checks the reason of every grade, whatever its status; `derive.rs:77` gives a reason only to `Unmet` entries (`missing`, `na`); the met line `render.rs:161` prints the evidence only; `JCell` (`render.rs:237`) has no key for it.
- The `met_reasons` key is written only when it has an entry, so a cell with no met reason is byte-equal to before: the golden fixtures `expected-conformance.md` and `expected-conformance.json` (no met grade with a reason) and `render_json_key_order` (a met grade with no reason) do not change.
- The new tests are new functions in `conformance.rs`; no existing test function, literal or fixture changes, so `## Test logic edits` is `None.`.
- Depends on CC-3 (it changed `crates/zygo-core/tests/conformance/model.rs` `clients()`, the module beside these files) and CC-12 (it changes the grade files and regenerates `docs/conformance.md` and `.json`, which this node regenerates again).

None of them is in `docs/conformance.md` or `docs/conformance.json`. CC-12 rewrites three OpenCode reasons (stale `hook_opencode::normalize` text); the count is checked again when the node starts.

- The golden fixtures `crates/zygo-core/tests/conformance/fixtures/alpha.toml` and `beta.toml` have no `met` grade with a reason, so they stay unchanged.
